conversations.texte: My name is Walter Hartwell White.
I live at 308 Negra Arroyo Lane, Albuquerque, New Mexico, 87104.
To all law enforcement entities, this is not an admission of guilt.
I am speaking to my family now.
Skyler, you are the love of my life. I hope you know that.
Walter Junior, you're my big man.
There are going to be some things.
Things that you'll come to learn about me in the next few days. I just want you to know that no matter how it may look, I only had you in my heart.
